title: CustomerProfile app configuration
description: App-level configuration for the CustomerProfile html-tool. Paste one of these objects into the CMS parameter named profileConfig.

appTitle.description: Title shown in the tool header. Example: Tutor Profiles.

labels.description: Defaults for user-facing words. Segment labels can override these.

defaultSegmentKey.description: Segment used for new records. Defaults to the first segment.

allowSegmentSelection.description: When false, the app is locked to defaultSegmentKey and no segment switch is shown.

segments.description: Customer types or profile types supported by this app.

definitions.description: Question sets owned by this app. They are merged with the tool's built-in question sets and with the optional profileDefinitions parameter.

record.description: Singular noun for one record. Example: Student.

questionSets.description: Plural label for question sets. Example: Forms.

key.description: Stable key stored on records. Never change it after records exist.

description.description: Short helper text shown in the segment switch and sidebar.

baseType.description: Which core identity fields to use: person names or company legal/trade/registration fields.

profileKeys.description: Fixed question sets for this segment. Required when allowProfileSelection is false.

allowedProfileKeys.description: Question sets a user may choose from when allowProfileSelection is true.

allowProfileSelection.description: True shows a question-set picker limited to allowedProfileKeys. False gives a fixed, vertical-specific form.

allowCombinations.description: Only meaningful when allowProfileSelection is true. True lets the user combine multiple allowed question sets.

allowFocusSelection.description: True shows focus-area chips. False shows the full fixed form.

allowProfileEditing.description: True exposes the question-set library and JSON editor. Keep false for a clean vertical app.

identityHint.description: Helper text under the identity heading.

nameFieldIds.description: Optional subset of core identity field ids. Person: core_firstName, core_lastName, core_preferredName, core_jobTitle. Company: core_legalName, core_tradeName, core_registrationNumber, core_taxNumber.

adminFieldIds.description: Optional subset of core admin field ids: core_status, core_priority, core_source, core_owner, core_since, core_nextFollowUp.

showAdminFields.description: False hides all admin fields for this segment. AdminFieldIds is applied first.

showTags.description: False hides the tags editor for this segment.

hiddenSectionIds.description: Optional core record sections to hide for this segment. Basic Information always remains. Available: contact, addresses, people, interactions, notes.

statusOptions.description: Status choices for this segment, replacing the tool-level status list.

sourceOptions.description: Source choices for this segment, replacing the tool-level source list.

key.description: Stable question-set key. Segment profileKeys/allowedProfileKeys reference this.

id.description: Stable section id. Keep it unique inside the question set.
Stable answer key. Changing it starts a new answer; old answers are preserved under the old id.

options.description: Required for select and multiselect fields.
